questions.questionText: What is ReactJS?
options: An open-source front-end JavaScript library for building component-based user interfaces
questions.correctAnswer: An open-source front-end JavaScript library for building component-based user interfaces
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) An open-source front-end JavaScript library for building component-based user interfaces.

questions.questionText: Which organization, assisted by a community of individual developers, maintains ReactJS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Meta (formerly Facebook).

questions.questionText: ReactJS is used only to build and render user interface components to the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Document Object Model (DOM).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of declarative views in ReactJS?
options: Developers must manually update the DOM after every change
Updates and renders the right components as data changes
questions.correctAnswer: Developers must manually update the DOM after every change
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Developers must manually update the DOM after every change.

questions.questionText: Which statement about component-based design in ReactJS is correct?
options: State must always be kept inside the DOM
Components cannot be combined to form complex UIs
An application can contain only one component
Components are capable of managing their own states
questions.correctAnswer: Components are capable of managing their own states
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Components are capable of managing their own states.

questions.questionText: In ReactJS, the logic of components is written using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) JavaScript instead of templates.

questions.questionText: What is Babel in the ReactJS ecosystem?
options: A JavaScript compiler that converts JavaScript code from one format to another
questions.correctAnswer: A JavaScript compiler that converts JavaScript code from one format to another
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A JavaScript compiler that converts JavaScript code from one format to another.

questions.questionText: What is Webpack?
options: A module bundler that bundles JavaScript modules and dependencies into a single file
questions.correctAnswer: A module bundler that bundles JavaScript modules and dependencies into a single file
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A module bundler that bundles JavaScript modules and dependencies into a single file.

questions.questionText: Which ecosystem component renders specific ReactJS components depending on the URL?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Routing (ReactJS Router).

questions.questionText: Which is described as the most popular CSS approach in the ReactJS styling ecosystem?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Styled Components.

questions.questionText: In Redux, all component state details are collated in a single location called the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Store.

questions.questionText: In Redux, the states in the Store change through:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Actions.

questions.questionText: Which statement about Redux is correct?
options: It is used within ReactJS and also with other view libraries
questions.correctAnswer: It is used within ReactJS and also with other view libraries
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) It is used within ReactJS and also with other view libraries.

questions.questionText: Which feature manages the state of a component without depending on external libraries?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Context API.

questions.questionText: Context in ReactJS provides a way to:
options: Pass data through the component tree without passing props down manually at every level
questions.correctAnswer: Pass data through the component tree without passing props down manually at every level
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Pass data through the component tree without passing props down manually at every level.

questions.questionText: The Context API was developed by the ReactJS team to avoid dependency on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) External libraries such as Redux.

questions.questionText: What is the Document Object Model (DOM)?
options: A structured, tree-based hierarchical representation of an HTML document created by the browser
questions.correctAnswer: A structured, tree-based hierarchical representation of an HTML document created by the browser
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A structured, tree-based hierarchical representation of an HTML document created by the browser.

questions.questionText: Why is it easier for scripting languages to interact with a Web page through the DOM?
options: Scripts can easily access and understand the structured format in the DOM
DOM stores data in a database
DOM removes the need for a browser
questions.correctAnswer: Scripts can easily access and understand the structured format in the DOM
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Scripts can easily access and understand the structured format in the DOM.

questions.questionText: What is the Virtual DOM?
options: A copy, clone, or virtual image of the DOM
questions.correctAnswer: A copy, clone, or virtual image of the DOM
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A copy, clone, or virtual image of the DOM.

questions.questionText: For every object in the DOM, the Virtual DOM has:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) An equivalent object.

questions.questionText: When the state of an element changes in a ReactJS application, the change is updated first in the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Virtual DOM.

questions.questionText: How many Virtual DOM trees does ReactJS manage while updating the UI?
options: Two (the updated version and the pre-update version)
questions.correctAnswer: Two (the updated version and the pre-update version)
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Two (the updated version and the pre-update version).

questions.questionText: What is the process of comparing the pre-updated Virtual DOM with the updated Virtual DOM known as?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Diffing.

questions.questionText: Why does ReactJS use batch updates for the real DOM?
options: To update the DOM after every single change
To avoid using the Virtual DOM
To update the real DOM together instead of after every single change
questions.correctAnswer: To update the real DOM together instead of after every single change
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) To update the real DOM together instead of after every single change.

questions.questionText: Which of the following are the core building blocks of ReactJS applications?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Components.

questions.questionText: In technical terms, each ReactJS component returns:
options: A part of JSX code indicating what must be rendered on the screen
questions.correctAnswer: A part of JSX code indicating what must be rendered on the screen
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A part of JSX code indicating what must be rendered on the screen.

questions.questionText: Functional components in ReactJS are:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) JavaScript functions.

questions.questionText: Which feature of JavaScript is used to create class-based components in ReactJS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) ES6 classes.

questions.questionText: Which statement about props is correct?
options: Props are read-only data received by a component
Props are used to manage private data
Props can flow from child to parent only
Props data can be modified by the receiving component
questions.correctAnswer: Props are read-only data received by a component
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Props are read-only data received by a component.

questions.questionText: Which statement about state is correct?
options: State is passed from parent to child
Components create and manage their own state, which is private to the component
Other components can freely modify a component's state
questions.correctAnswer: Components create and manage their own state, which is private to the component
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Components create and manage their own state, which is private to the component.

questions.questionText: In ReactJS, data flow is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Unidirectional, from parent to child.

questions.questionText: What does JSX stand for?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) JavaScript XML.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an advantage of JSX?
options: It forces markup and logic into separate files
Errors can be found during compiling
It cannot be used with Babel
questions.correctAnswer: Errors can be found during compiling
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Errors can be found during compiling.

questions.questionText: Which tool is used as a pre-processor to read and convert JSX into standard JavaScript?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Babel.

questions.questionText: How many stages are there in the lifecycle of a ReactJS component as described in the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Four.

questions.questionText: Which of the following lists the stages of the component lifecycle in order?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Initialization, Mounting, Updating, Unmounting.

questions.questionText: In which lifecycle stage is a component removed from the DOM?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Unmounting.

questions.questionText: The componentDidMount() method is called in which stage?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Mounting.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript runtime must be installed for a ReactJS development environment?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) NodeJS.

questions.questionText: Which IDE is installed in the session for writing ReactJS code?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Visual Studio Code.

questions.questionText: Which command installs the create-react-app library globally?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) npm i -g create-react-app.

questions.questionText: Which version of the Node.js installer is downloaded in the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 18.14.2.

questions.questionText: Which version of ReactJS is used in the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 18.2.0.

questions.questionText: Which command is used in the integrated terminal to create a new ReactJS app?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) npx create-react-app.

questions.questionText: In the sample app creation, which command starts the development server after moving into the app folder?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) npm start.

questions.questionText: How can a running ReactJS application be stopped from the terminal?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Press Ctrl+C.

questions.questionText: According to the default ReactJS welcome page, which file should be edited to change the app?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) src/App.js.

questions.questionText: In the NodeJS installation, the option "Automatically install the necessary tools" is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Optional.

questions.questionText: Which is an advantage of using an IDE like Visual Studio Code for ReactJS?
options: It hosts the application on the internet
It replaces the need for NodeJS
It reduces development time and auto-generates base code such as component definitions
questions.correctAnswer: It reduces development time and auto-generates base code such as component definitions
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) It reduces development time and auto-generates base code such as component definitions.

questions.questionText: Why is the Virtual DOM faster to work with than the real DOM?
options: Because it does not use JavaScript
Because it is stored on the server
Because only the updated part is rendered on the Web page after comparing versions
questions.correctAnswer: Because only the updated part is rendered on the Web page after comparing versions
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Because only the updated part is rendered on the Web page after comparing versions.

questions.questionText: Single-page and mobile applications and server-rendered applications (with frameworks like Next.js) can be developed with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) ReactJS.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about traditional styling in the ReactJS ecosystem?
options: It includes styling details in the index.css file and can use SASS or CSS pre-processors
questions.correctAnswer: It includes styling details in the index.css file and can use SASS or CSS pre-processors
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) It includes styling details in the index.css file and can use SASS or CSS pre-processors.
